name: block-data-table
summary: Sortable, paginated table shell generic over the row type, with aria-sort and an empty state.
description: A Web client block that renders typed columns over the rows passed in: sortable headers with aria-sort, optional row-header cells, client-side pagination with labelled controls and an announced page status, and an empty state across all columns. Built from the Table and Button primitives and theme tokens; all copy arrives through props and it fetches nothing.
use_when: a page lists records such as members, orders, invoices, or audit entries
the builder asks for a sortable or paginated table
a list needs an empty state and accessible sorting without a heavy grid library
